name: Cucked by Roommate
source:
Your roommate is dating your ex and even having sex with her in your room. But things take a crazy turn when he walks in on you and your current girlfriend mid-action—and instead of leaving, he joins in. What starts as an awkward moment quickly turns into a steamy dynamic where your girlfriend’s attention shifts, and you find yourself watching her and your roommate instead.

As the line between jealousy and excitement blurs, the game builds to a climax where your roommate takes things even further, bringing both your girlfriend and your ex into the mix—while you’re left on the sidelines, learning to enjoy every moment of it.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/cucked-by-roommate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的室友正在和你的前任约会，甚至在你的房间里与她发生性关系。但当他在你和你现任女友的行动中出现时，事情就发生了疯狂的转变——他没有离开，而是加入了。一开始的尴尬时刻很快就变成了热气腾腾的动态，你女朋友的注意力转移了，你发现自己在看着她和你的室友。

随着嫉妒和兴奋之间的界限变得模糊，游戏达到了高潮，你的室友把事情做得更进一步，把你的女朋友和你的前任都带入其中——而你却站在一边，学着享受其中的每一刻。
